description: Create a video card and a one-time upload URL; the bytes go with HTTP PUT to upload.url, not through this connector. If you can run commands where the file is, send them yourself (see Next); only if you cannot, use the upload button (data-dcast-upload) or import_video_from_url.

visibility.description: PUBLIC (listed), LINK_ONLY (by link, not listed) or PRIVATE (owner only)
